Messages.Author: Stingray
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I wonder if it possible to play 'Mask of 1,000 Faces' when
you attack your opponents minion with your Muddled Vampire
Hunter, or better: I know you can. The question is, can
the Hunter strike his '4 damage first strike' and then
just between strike and resolution I play Mask o'Faces to
absorb my opponents minions hit with another of my minions.

As it it an action modifier, which can be played at any
time during an action and the card reads "...the action
resumes where it left off". My assumption would be: YES,
you can play the Mask at absolutely any time and switch 
your minions at any point in the action.

Has anyone got an opinion about this?

Messages.Author: Brian Wilson
Messages.Body:

> I wonder if it possible to play 'Mask of 1,000 Faces' when

> Hunter, or better: I know you can. The question is, can
> the Hunter strike his '4 damage first strike' and then
> just between strike and resolution I play Mask o'Faces to
> absorb my opponents minions hit with another of my minions.

> As it it an action modifier, which can be played at any
> time during an action and the card reads "...the action
> resumes where it left off". My assumption would be: YES,
> you can play the Mask at absolutely any time and switch 
> your minions at any point in the action.


You can pretty much play it any time you want. My favorite trick with the 
Mask is to hand an Ivory Bow or Flame Thrower to one minion, than attempt 
a bleed with another minion on the next turn. When they block the *other* 
one, I whip out the Mask and let the guy with the Bow do his dirty work. 
A really aggravating card.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Mask of 1000 Faces is an action modifier, not a combat card, so can't
be used during combat.
